name: officegrep
description: Full-text search inside Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF files, with paragraph/slide/cell/page locators.
long_description: officegrep extracts text from local .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .pdf and plain-text files into a single SQLite FTS5 index and exposes it to the agent as three tools: search_docs, list_docs and index_folder. Every hit carries a human-readable locator so the agent knows where the text lives. The index is local, incremental and works offline; CJK and Latin text are matched with the same trigram tokenizer, no embedding service required.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across indexed documents; returns path, locator and a highlighted snippet.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List indexed files with their text-block counts.

tools.name: index_folder
tools.description: Build or refresh the index for a folder or file (incremental).

db_path.title: Index database
db_path.description: Where to keep the SQLite index file.
